plainTranslation: Composite Mercury in the 6 House: With Composite Mercury in the 6th house, this is the house of work and is one of the houses naturally ruled by Mercury, so this can be a good placement for a work relationship, though it may be best for an employee-employer relationship rather than an equal partnership. In a personal relationship, you may have the tendency to nitpick with one another, and need to make sure you’re not getting lost in the little daily details and losing sight of the entire relationship.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
